oneLine: Carlyle Group plans a USD 400 million IPO for Highway Roop Precision Technologies.

sources.title: Carlyle Group Plans $400 Million IPO For India Auto Parts Platform Highway Roop Precision Technologies

synopsis: Private equity firm Carlyle Group has begun preparations for a potential initial public offering of its India-based automotive components platform, Highway Roop Precision Technologies. The proposed share sale could raise up to $400 million, approximately 3,348 crore INR, and may take place in the first half of next year. The offering is expected to include both a fresh equity issuance and shares sold by existing investors, though final size, valuation, and timing remain under discussion and subject to market conditions. The company has reportedly appointed investment banks Kotak Mahindra Capital, JM Financial, Goldman Sachs, and Nomura as advisers for the transaction. Carlyle established Highway Roop Precision Technologies after acquiring controlling stakes in Highway Industries and Roop Automotives.
